scope: workflow integration and external technical review assets

items.title: Reviewer Decision Tree
items.done_when: A reviewer can pick the right DotMatch entry path without broad assay claims.

items.title: Persona One-Pagers
items.primary_audience: core facilities, CRISPR teams, workflow maintainers, assay developers
items.done_when: Each priority reviewer group has a workflow use case, evidence path, and first command.

items.title: Integration Target Tracker
items.done_when: Every target integration has an upstream URL, readiness state, source assets, and next action.

items.title: Reviewer Packet
items.done_when: A reviewer can find install proof, outputs, limitations, evidence, and citation text from one checklist.

items.title: Conference Abstracts
items.done_when: Short and long abstracts are ready for workflow, core facility, and methods venues.

items.title: Technical Communication Pack
items.done_when: Release notes, technical threads, and forum prompts stay scoped to validated behavior.

items.title: Maintainer Issue Templates
items.done_when: External issue or PR openings can be copied with scope, outputs, tests, and review asks.

items.title: Evaluation Scorecard
items.done_when: Evaluation feedback can be scored against install, input mapping, outputs, workflow fit, methods text, and public-use permission.

items.title: Integration Tracking Metrics
items.done_when: The project tracks workflow interest separately from scientific claims and release quality.

items.title: Release Publication Checklist
items.done_when: Each release has a pre-merge, tag, channel-verification, and public-record update checklist.
